scientific_integrity: The claim is proved directly from exact closed-neighborhood counts and separately stress-tested by exhaustive enumeration. The scalar minimum is presented as a corollary of the all-set classification, not as evidence for it.
scientific_limitations: Specific to crown graphs and uniform closed-neighborhood k-tuple domination. The exhaustive checker covers n through 8 and is only a finite consistency check; the symbolic proof supplies the infinite result. Residual bibliographic risk remains that an obscure source may contain a special scalar or k=2 case.
title: All \(k\)-tuple dominating sets of crown graphs
